title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05

ai_review.summary: Solid early‑morning US Fest ’82 show with tight Playin’→Shakedown→Minglewood and a good‑quality soundboard capture
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic opening sequence (Playin' into Shakedown Street) and a standout Munglewood Blues, plus a well‑executed China Cat Sunflower/I Know You Rider transition. The recording is a soundboard source that is generally clear, though a few listeners note occasional piano distortion and brief mix quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight strong playing and a decent soundboard, with only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp overall, slight waviness in places, occasional piano distortion on Brent’s keys, and a brief early cut of the Rider segment.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑morning festival set opens strong with Playin' into Shakedown, flows smoothly into Minglewood and the China/Rider sequence; second set keeps momentum with spacey jams and a powerful drums/encore finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar melts into Shakedown quickly, noted for strong tone though some felt it rushed the transition.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass presence is solid; Phil’s low‑end work shines during the space segment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's piano is praised but occasionally sounds distorted in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drums > encore segment is highlighted as a favorite moment.
